fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Missing Kids Readiness Program (MKRP) Training Registration

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro Copy
fields.value: Register your agency or emergency communications center for Missing Kids Readiness Program training.

fields.name: formAction
fields.label: Submit Endpoint URL
fields.description: Use http://127.0.0.1:8787/training-application for local mock testing. Production native submits should point to a Laravel endpoint that stores the payload in a training applications table.

fields.name: successMessage
fields.label: Success Message
fields.value: Thank you. Your training registration has been submitted. The Training team will review your application and respond within two business days.

fields.name: errorMessage
fields.label: Error Message
fields.value: We could not submit your training registration. Please try again.

fields.name: topPadding
fields.label: Top Padding (Optional)
fields.description: Accepts CSS lengths like 64px, 4rem, or 0. Plain numbers default to px.

fields.name: submissionMode
fields.label: Submission Mode
fields.description: Native Form posts the redesigned form to the backend endpoint. Original AEM Embed renders the current AEM Adaptive Form.

fields.name: embedUrl
fields.label: Original AEM Form URL
fields.description: Used only when Submission Mode is Original AEM Embed.
